from pathlib import Path
import os
Path('outputs').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
Path('outputs/checkpoint.csv').write_text('label,value\na,2\nb,3\n', encoding='utf-8')
raise ValueError('after checkpoint publication')

rows <- read.csv('outputs/checkpoint.csv')
stopifnot(sum(rows$value) == 5)
write.table(rows, 'outputs/transferred.tsv', sep='\t', row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE)

content = Path('outputs/transferred.tsv').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
assert 'a\t2' in content and 'b\t3' in content
Path('outputs/final.tmp').write_text(content, encoding='utf-8')
os.replace('outputs/final.tmp', 'outputs/final.tsv')
